lines.en: Our class project is about climate change.
lines.vi: Dự án của lớp mình là về biến đổi khí hậu.
Nguyên nhân gây biến đổi khí hậu là gì?

lines.en: If we use renewable energy, we will reduce pollution.

writing.target: Climate change is a big problem.
Global warming makes the ice melt.

text_en: Thousands of colourful fish and sea animals live there.
However, many reefs are in danger.
Global warming is making the sea warmer, and the coral is turning white.
Plastic and chemicals from rivers also harm the reefs.
If we don't take action, many reefs will disappear.
We can reduce plastic waste and use reusable bottles.
We can save energy at home.
When we visit the beach, we should never touch the coral or leave litter.
If everyone helps, the reefs will have a future.

questions.q: Why is the coral turning white?
What should we never do at the beach?
options: Touch the coral or leave litter.
questions.answer: Touch the coral or leave litter.
